title: spec(ai): the blueprint field's `expression` describe tells the design model "null for every other field type", so the AI builder cannot author a totallable computed field (#32443 B, #32598)
body:
coordinator#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2dYynaMYbZTr8hTeRC

Filing gate: ① product defect with a named real producer: the cloud AI builder, whose design model reads this describe (cloud#3567 B9, recorded on #32443 comment 6813682448). Found while filing #32598 on the maintainer's instruction 「两张 cloud 卡，你直接写，挂 cloud 标签就可以」 (project thread, 2026-11-12T07:10Z). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade.
Reader: `domain:spec`, `packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts` (the lenient `BlueprintFieldSchema.expression` and the strict `StrictField.expression`), next PR that touches the blueprint field.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `solution-blueprint expression` → 25 hits, `blueprint expression number field` → 27, `StrictField expression` → 5; none covers this. Nearest precedent: #30584 (closed, blueprint field `defaultValue`, the same lenient/strict pair).
reach: named real producer. The cloud builder authored 销售额 = 销量 × 单价 as a `formula` and every sum over it was refused (cloud#3567 B9). #32443 (ruled B, route 1 accepted 2026-11-12) says a value meant to be totalled is a field of its return type carrying the same `expression`. The design model is told the opposite by this describe.
Related: #32598 (the cloud builder and analytics card, which depends on this one), #32443, PR #32545, #32532 (published skills).

## Measured

At objectstack `main` `3452dec2`, `packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts`:

- `StrictField.expression` (`z.string().nullable()`, about line 614): "REQUIRED when type is "formula" … **null for every other field type**." The strict mirror is the shape the design model generates against, so it is told never to put an expression on a `number` / `currency` / `date` field.
- `BlueprintFieldSchema.expression` (`z.string().optional()`, about line 298): describes only the `formula` case.
- Neither schema refuses an `expression` on a non-formula field, so the SHAPE already admits route 1. Only the describes steer away from it.
- The data contract allows it: `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`, `expression`: on any other (stored) field it is "computed by the engine from the row the write stores and stored". `judgeRestrictionProfile` does not read fields, so every hosted tier allows it (read from code).

Not measured here: whether cloud's `apply_blueprint` carries `expression` onto a non-formula field when it builds the object. #32598 asks the cloud seat to measure that.

## Ask

1. Rewrite both describes, in lockstep, to teach the two uses of `expression`:
   - on `type: "formula"`: computed on read, stored nowhere, cannot be totalled, sorted or searched (keep the existing one-hop and runtime-dead text);
   - on a field of the value's own return type (`number`, `currency`, `percent`, `date`, …): computed by the engine on every write and kept in a column, so `sum` / `avg`, sort and search work. Use this when the value is totalled, averaged or charted. Name the return type, not "number": a date expression on a number field is refused at every write.
   - Replace "null for every other field type" with: null on a field that is neither a formula nor a stored computed value.
2. Keep the shape unchanged (no accept-set change); this is describe text the design model reads. Regenerate whatever the spec gate says the describe change touches.
3. Use the remedy wording PR #32545 lands, so the refusal, the blueprint and the skills (#32532) say the same sentence.

## Acceptance notes

- The two describes name both uses and agree with each other and with `field.zod.ts`.
- A spec test pins that a blueprint field `{ type: 'number', expression: 'record.quantity * record.unit_price' }` parses under both schemas and keeps its `expression`.
- After landing, post the merge sha on #32598 so the cloud seat can run its pin probe.
